Package model.dungeon

Class Dungeon

java.lang.Object
model.dungeon.Dungeon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Dungeon extends Object implements Serializable
Represents one of the Dungeons that must be completed to rescue an Idol.

Contains the list of Floors in the dungeon and tracks which one the Player is in.

  • Method Details

    • generateDungeon

      public void generateDungeon(Idol idol)
      Generates the dungeon based on which Idol the player decided to save first. Gets the corresponding DungeonCode from the Idol and generates floors from that dungeon. The number of floors generated is based on the challenge order of the dungeon.

      After generating the floors, it spawns the Player in the first one.

      Parameters:
      idol - the Idol that the Player chose to save.

    • generateFinalDungeon

      public void generateFinalDungeon()
      Generates the Final Dungeon of the game. Generates the lair of the Siren, the final boss. Contains only one floor.

    • generateFloors

      private void generateFloors(DungeonCode dungeonCode, int maxFloor)
      Generates a number of floors equal to the max number of floors for the dungeon. It initializes each floor and runs the Floor.generateFloor method on it. It passes the DungeonCode to generate the corresponding type of Floor.
      Parameters:
      dungeonCode - the type of dungeon this is.
      maxFloor - the number of floors to generate.

    • generateFinalFloor

      Generates the Final Floor.

    • finishDungeon

      public void finishDungeon()
      Increments the order of the dungeon by 1. When the dungeon is finished, the next dungeon overwrites the floors here. In order to reflect the challenge order of the dungeons, the order is incremented by 1 as this is the next dungeon to be challenged.

    • finishDungeonHacks

      public void finishDungeonHacks()
      A Method used in debugging. Used to instantly finish a dungeon by increasing the order by one.

    • tick

      public boolean tick(char choice)
      Processes one cycle of player input.

      Calls the Floor.tick method to process the choice and changes there. If that method returns true, that indicates that the Floor is finished. If the Floor has been finished and there is another Floor this increments the current floor by 1 and spawns the Player at the next Floor. Otherwise, if there are no remaining Floors, this calls finishDungeon and returns true to signal the ModuleLayer.Controller that the current Dungeon was completed.

      Parameters:
      choice - the input character representing the player's choice.
      Returns:
      true if the Dungeon has been finished, false if not. This notifies the Controller if the dungeon is finished.
